messages.text: Great! Now hop on into the Minecart and I'll get you on your way!
messages.zh: 太好了! 赶紧跳上矿车,我这就送你出发!
messages.raw: §fGreat! Now hop on into the Minecart and I'll get you on your way!
§fGood luck in the mines!
messages.text: Good luck in the mines!
messages.zh: 祝你在矿里一切顺利!

messages.raw: §cOh no! It looks like you missed the Minecart!
messages.text: Oh no! It looks like you missed the Minecart!
messages.zh: 糟糕! 看来你没赶上矿车!

messages.text: Hey! Someone special has been asking to meet you!

segments.text: has been asking to meet you!

messages.text: I'm not quite sure what he's doing back in the Dwarven Mines- it's been years since I last saw him!

messages.text: Anyways, he's expecting you over in the Hanging Court by the Royal Palace. Better not keep him waiting!

segments.text: Anyways, he's expecting you over in the
segments.zh: 总之,他在皇家宫殿旁边的

segments.text: by the Royal Palace. Better not keep him waiting!

messages.raw: §fOne day I will be useful.
messages.text: One day I will be useful.
messages.zh: 总有一天我会派上用场的。

messages.raw: §fI don't really have a sweet tooth, but chocolate is probably my favorite thing in this world. But the supply is really poor mostly because of the mines' lack of accessibility.
messages.text: I don't really have a sweet tooth, but chocolate is probably my favorite thing in this world. But the supply is really poor mostly because of the mines' lack of accessibility.
messages.zh: 我其实不怎么爱吃甜的,不过巧克力大概是这世上我最喜欢的东西了。只是矿里进出太不方便,货源实在太差。

messages.raw: §fAmazing! I haven't eaten such chocolatey goodness in a long time...Maybe they should invest in that rusty old lift.
messages.text: Amazing! I haven't eaten such chocolatey goodness in a long time...Maybe they should invest in that rusty old lift.
messages.zh: 太棒了! 我好久没吃到这么浓的巧克力了……也许他们真该在那台老掉牙的升降梯上花点钱。

messages.raw: §fI helped you enter the Crystal Hollows so many times! Why won't you return the favor?
messages.text: I helped you enter the Crystal Hollows so many times! Why won't you return the favor?
messages.zh: 我帮你进了那么多次水晶残核! 你怎么就不肯还我个人情呢?

messages.raw: §fMany treasures await you blah, blah, blah... Get in the Minecart!
messages.text: Many treasures await you blah, blah, blah... Get in the Minecart!
messages.zh: 无数宝藏正等着你,等等等等……快上矿车!

messages.raw: §fWhat are you waiting for? Christmas? Get in!
messages.text: What are you waiting for? Christmas? Get in!
messages.zh: 你还在等什么?等过年吗?快上车!

messages.context: 玩家迟迟不上车时的催促,语气随意甚至带粗口式感叹词
messages.text: Just get in the heckin Minecart already.
messages.gloss: 'heckin' 是 'heck'(damn 的委婉替代词)的口语化变形,翻译时用类似轻微粗口的语气词对应即可,不需要逐字直译。
messages.zh: 赶紧给我上这破矿车。
messages.raw: §fJust get in the heckin Minecart already.
§fGo on, in you get.
messages.text: Go on, in you get.
messages.zh: 快点,上车吧。

messages.raw: §fThe Minecart will leave without you...
messages.text: The Minecart will leave without you...
messages.zh: 矿车可要丢下你开走了……

messages.raw: §fThat Minecart won't wait forever you know.
messages.text: That Minecart won't wait forever you know.
messages.zh: 那辆矿车可不会永远等着你。

messages.text: I'll grant you access to the Crystal Hollows for %s hours, for only %s coins!
messages.gloss: 原文用的是 %s 顺序占位符,已按位置编号 %1$s/%2$s 标注,方便中文调整语序时不错位。
messages.zh: 我可以让你进入水晶残核%1$s小时,只要%2$s硬币!

messages.context: 玩家达到山之心 7 级(罗马数字 VII)后触发的剧情引导
messages.text: Hey! Someone special has been asking to meet you! Anyways, he's expecting you over in the Hanging Court.
messages.gloss: Hanging Court 是专有地点名。
messages.zh: 嘿! 有个特别的人一直想见你! 总之,他在悬廷等着你了。
